quotes.text: Ahab commanded the presence of his .prophets — a numerous band of 400. To them he said, “Shall I go against Ramoth- GUead to battle, or shall I forbear?” They all obsequiously replied, “ Go up ; for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king.”
